query: image_hidream_o1_dev template produces a grey image (or pure noise for others, incl. fp8/mxfp8 variants; edit mode broken) even with default prompts and correct model placement. Root cause: the ImageScaleToTotalPixels node in the template is bypassed, corrupting the image path.

desired.outcome: Commenter smithian123 (2026-05-19): un-bypassing the ImageScaleToTotalPixels node fixed the grey output. Affects anyone who runs the template as shipped since the node ships bypassed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
